Applied literally, that refuses every placement on every applied payload that lacks the slot. 35 test files call apply_policy, and qip-acceptance suites among them (order_placement_paths and others in this lane's gate). Their fixtures would all need a books slot. On the shipped path, qip-api's payload producer (apps/qip-api/src/mesh.rs) has no source for who owns which book. That source would be an operator-declared assignment, and declaring it in a deployment needs infrastructure/environments or variables.tf, both protected. Without it the default paper path would stop trading. Decision needed from a person: what the producer emits when no assignment is declared (all books to the one cell, or the ADR's fail-closed stop), and whether the fixture fallout is accepted. I built nothing, so no half-wired gate that fires nowhere.
